lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li4Ga4Se8 (reduced formula LiGaSe2) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral coordination for Ga and Li centers, each with six Se neighbors, while Se centers show a close-packed-like arrangement with twelve neighbors (four Ga and eight Li). The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Ga and Li octahedra, edge-sharing between like Ga and like Li octahedra, and both corner- and face-sharing between Se polyhedra.
